# `core/memory/RenderBundleCache.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/memory/RenderBundleCache.js`

RenderBundleCache.js - Pre-recorded Render Commands for Voxel Terrain Render bundles dramatically reduce CPU overhead by pre-recording render commands. Instead of issuing thousands of draw calls per frame, we execute a single bundle. Based on: https://toji.dev/webgpu-best-practices/render-bundles.html Benefits: - Skip JS→C++→GPU process validation each frame - 50-80% reduction in CPU render time - Frees CPU for other work (physics, AI, etc.) Limitations: - Bundle must be recreated when chunks load/unload - Bind groups and pipelines are locked at creation time - Best for relatively static scenes

## Classes

| `invalidate` | `invalidate()` | Mark bundles as needing rebuild (call when chunks change) |
| `needsRebuild` | `needsRebuild(currentChunkCount)` | Check if bundles need rebuild |
| `buildOpaqueBundle` | `buildOpaqueBundle(pipeline, frameBindGroup, chunks, options = {})` | Build opaque terrain render bundle |
| `buildWaterBundle` | `buildWaterBundle(pipeline, frameBindGroup, chunks, options = {})` | Build water/transparent render bundle |
| `executeOpaqueBundle` | `executeOpaqueBundle(renderPass)` | Execute the opaque bundle |
| `executeWaterBundle` | `executeWaterBundle(renderPass)` | Execute the water bundle |
| `getStats` | `getStats()` | Get statistics |
| `loadConfig` | `loadConfig(cfg)` | Load configuration from engine.cfg section |
| `destroy` | `destroy()` | Destroy cached bundles |
